title: Deodeok and Syrian Flatbread Pizza
description: A unique fusion of Korean and Middle Eastern flavors in a crispy flatbread crust.

ingredients.name: Deodeok
ingredients.amount: 2 medium roots, peeled and thinly sliced

instructions: Cut the Syrian flatbread into individual pieces, about 2-3 inches in diameter.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced deodeok, yeasty cheese alternative, olive oil, salt, black pepper, sesame seeds, chopped cilantro, soy sauce, and garlic powder.
Brush the flatbread pieces with a little water and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Place a few slices of deodeok mixture on each flatbread piece, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the flatbread in half to enclose the filling.
Place the flatbread pizzas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the flatbread is crispy and golden brown.
